text:
kate: quick brain-dump  want to run a 1-week micro experiment tying a short webinar + landing variations to see which competitive message brings better infra/platform MQLs. goal: finalize a battlecard snippet and two headline families.

omar: love it. what hypothesis are we testing?

kate: two hypotheses: 1) econ-led hooks (cost + throughput) will pull more PLG/demo signups, 2) ops-led hooks (SLOs/fallbacks) will pull more enterprise brief requests. also a tertiary test: portability messaging for platform teams.

li: recommend we keep claims soft: e.g., "teams see up to 3x lower serving costs (typical customer)" and a tiny benchmark tile on the card. legal hates absolutes.

nina: noted. benchmark tile should be compact: p95/p99 latency ranges, tokens/sec example, and a one-line note: "internal benchmark; results vary."

kate: routing plan: econ -> /lightning-demo?utm=mk_econ (immediate sandbox access), ops -> /enterprise-brief?utm=mk_ops (short form), portability -> /tech-note?utm=mk_port. ops-bot: can you create routes?

sdre-bot: deploy task created: MKG-10122. Routes: /lightning-demo?utm=mk_econ, /enterprise-brief?utm=mk_ops, /tech-note?utm=mk_port. Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.test/mkg/10122

omar: creatives: 2 headline variants per axis, 3 hero comps, two CTA treatments: "Try demo" vs "Request briefing". let's also test the CTA microcopy: "Instant sandbox" vs "Schedule 15-min".

li: SDR playbook: short 1-liners per competitor claim (cost, portability, reliability). keep them <2 sentences and include an escalation path for procurement asks. example: "Pricing: per-token usage + reserved capacity options; Console shows per-route spend."

kate: include a model-parity line: "Matches open model quality; our edge is serving economics and ops." keep it neutral.

eng-bot: note: add a short code snippet for in-app tutorial linking to batching recipe docs in the demo flow.

nina: timeline: headlines + landing copy by Tue EOD, landing up Wed AM, ads Thu morning for 5 days. small paid test on LinkedIn: econ vs ops, $1k budget.

omar: analytics: capture `lead_profile` (hosted|dedicated|private) + utm_source. report CTR -> MQL and cost-per-qualified. share Monday AM.

li: legal: I'll add the "typical customer" attribution and run a quick check on any specific numbers.

kate: deliverables recap: battlecard snippet + 6 headline variants, landing routes with UTMs, SDR rebut snippets, one benchmark tile, ad creatives, dashboard. i'll drop the draft battlecard in #marketing for rapid review Wed morning. :rocket: 

omar: will mock hero images and two hero slide options. pinging design. :paintbrush:

sdre-bot: reminder scheduled: MKG-10122 deploy check Wed 09:00 UTC.
